definitions.explanation: Fibers in the body that transmit signals between the brain and other parts of the body.
One's mental state, sensitivity to things, or disposition.

examples.japanese: {神経|しんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}む→痛む：03008_itamu⟧。

examples.english: I had the nerve in my tooth removed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自律|じりつ}{神経|しんけい}→自律神経：08621_jiritsushinkei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}し→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧⟦やすい→～やすい：18367_yasui⟧。
examples.english: When the autonomic nervous system becomes unbalanced, it's easy to feel unwell.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神経|しんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧。
examples.english: He is very sensitive / pays attention to details.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神経|しんけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦さわる→障る：19589_sawaru⟧。
examples.english: That sound gets on my nerves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{神経|しんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}ぶる→高ぶる：28051_takaburu⟧。
examples.english: I get nervous when speaking in front of many people.

notes:
{神経|しんけい} is used for both physical nerves and psychological sensitivity.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {神経|しんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧ (sensitive, detail-oriented)
- {神経|しんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧ (thick-skinned, insensitive - often negative)
- {神経|しんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to be nervous, to pay careful attention)
- {神経|しんけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦さわる→障る：19589_sawaru⟧ (to get on one's nerves)
- {神経|しんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}ぶる→高ぶる：28051_takaburu⟧ (nerves are on edge)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{神経|しんけい}{質|しつ}→神経質：07606_shinkeishitsu⟧ (nervous temperament)
- ⟦{神経|しんけい}{科|か}→神経科：28050_shinkeika⟧ (neurology department)
- ⟦{自律|じりつ}{神経|しんけい}→自律神経：08621_jiritsushinkei⟧ (autonomic nervous system)
